rationale: The eight one-slider filters were the thin cluster; they stay on URLs but are noindex and off the sitemap. The remaining 16 each have a distinct input contract, output, or decoder. Pairwise SEO-body Jaccard is below 0.45. Merging them into a mega-converter would hide search intent (jpg to png, heic to jpg) and would silently accept the wrong file type. Differentiating further would be padding. This is the final catalog shape.

rejected_options.differentiate: Already unique About/How-to/FAQ and accept/output contracts. Extra copy would be filler.
rejected_options.consolidate: Would collapse inverse jobs (jpg↔png), PNG-only vs multi WebP, mirror vs 90° rotate, encode vs paste-decode Base64, and vendor decoders (HEIC/TIFF) onto one widget. That is worse UX and a weaker AdSense story than honest one-job pages.
